steps.title: A declared, validated sort
steps.body: The sort select is bound to ?sort(plays, title, created_on) in the template — the sortable set is declared there and checked at compile time, not in this Python file.

steps.title: Every tab follows
steps.body: Press play. Every open tab's count updates — a write plus a watch, nothing polled.

steps.title: Idempotent by construction
steps.body: Add an album twice with the same title and artist: the nested write's xid is deterministic, so the second attempt updates instead of duplicating. Then open any album for the next stop.

steps.title: Three ways to touch a link-set
steps.body: Add a genre is additive (stack). Dismiss one chip removes just that one (sync). Clear removes them all (slice).

steps.title: The batch behind first paint
steps.html: This is music.xsql, the file the pages are generated from. Find the @batch the dashboard's first paint uses — counters and chart in one round trip.
